description: Nestled on one of Cole Valley's most picturesque tree-lined streets, just half a block from the neighborhood's vibrant main corridor, this recently built residence blends contemporary style with timeless comfort. Thoughtfully designed with modern finishes throughout, the home showcases wide-plank white oak floors, recessed lighting, designer tilework, and new systems.  The spacious eat-in kitchen is appointed with abundant shaker-style cabinetry, sleek gray stone countertops, premium stainless steel appliances, and a large peninsula with seating that flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas. Filled with natural light, the inviting living room opens through French doors to a generous private deck and landscaped garden, creating an effortless and sought-after indoor-outdoor connection.  The primary bedroom features custom white oak built-ins and an expansive walk-in closet, while the second bedroomwith large French doors opening to the gardenoffers an ideal setting for a guest room or home office. The spa-like main bath includes both a soaking tub and walk-in shower. A powder room, dedicated laundry room, and additional storage add convenience and functionality.  Ideally located with a Walk Score of 98, near Golden Gate Park and convenient access to public transportation, this home offers the best of refined city living in the heart of Cole Valley.
